items.program_name: 雇用創出税額控除(OH JCTC)
items.summary: Ohio Tax Credit AuthorityがPacific Scientific Energetic Materials Company(オハイオ州Solon)に対し、雇用創出税額控除(JCTC、8年間1.420%)を承認。新規雇用75人・年間給与$5.0Mの増加が条件。
items.infer: 受領者は火工品(エネルギー物質)を製造する防衛関連企業であり、雇用増加を伴う事業拡大は生産設備・加工機の増設投資の可能性(推論)。
items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a Job Creation Tax Credit of 1.420% for 8 years on 2026-06-29 for a project in the City of Solon, Cuyahoga County. Commitment: create 75 full-time equivalent employees generating $5,000,000 in new annual payroll at the project location.
